checkpoint_rule: Minimum inner validation LogLoss for every architecture/objective
family_selection: Among three challenger families, highest mean inner NDCG across all seeds subject to mean LogLoss <= 1.005 * MLP-BCE; ties use family name. If none qualify, diagnose best challenger but block promotion.

quality_gate.comparison: Representative seed 42 vs freshly fitted LightGBM on outer validation

test_policy: Never read original test. Inner split and outer validation are development evidence, not a new independent holdout.
